objective: determine whether one-layer artifact-exact QAT improves exact ternary reconstruction outside its sampled training rows and whether that improvement transfers to generation

predecessor.reason_for_new_rung: v2 reduced in-cache reconstruction loss by 31.57 percent but was worse than direct PTQ on CUTE; v3 separates training, selection, and independent reconstruction rows before evaluating the exact model artifact

frozen_inputs.eval_overlap_policy: no CUTE-Quick-20 or MATH-500 evaluation row appears in the activation cache

train.semantics: first cached row from each of knowledge, math, code, instruction, multilingual, and reasoning

validation_selection.semantics: second knowledge, code, and multilingual rows; used to select an exact artifact

independent_test.semantics: second math, instruction, and reasoning rows; never used for optimization or checkpoint selection

candidate.all_other_tensors: byte-identical to the frozen BF16 GGUF parent

training.artifact_selection: minimum validation normalized reconstruction loss across exact hard artifacts, including step zero direct PTQ
training.completion_survival_phase: disabled because the v2 survival phase changed no exported value

mandatory_evaluation.invalid_run_rule: missing or infrastructure-failed reports are invalid, never zero

decision_rules.training_value: candidate must improve independent-test normalized reconstruction loss by at least 1 percent relative to direct PTQ
decision_rules.generation_non_regression: candidate must score at least direct PTQ on both CUTE-Quick-20 and pinned MATH-500 and may not lose a sealed code trace
decision_rules.likelihood_non_regression: candidate WikiText perplexity must not be measurably worse than direct PTQ
decision_rules.depth_expansion: forbidden regardless of this tiny rung; a passing result only authorizes a broader non-evaluation calibration and held-out experiment

claim_boundary: this is a one-layer diagnostic on Qwen3.5-4B, not whole-model ternary training and not a breakthrough
